model.name: NitroFusion2 Z-Image Turbo 6B
model.description: NitroFusion2 creates images from a text prompt in 1 to 4 steps, 2 by default, instead of the 8 steps of Z-Image Turbo, with sharp details and legible text. It is an adversarially distilled Z-Image Turbo finetune with the same memory needs and no guidance.

prompt: A rainy night market street in Taipei, a glowing shop sign that reads "NITRO NOODLES" in bold red letters, steam rising from a bowl on the counter, reflections on the wet pavement, cinematic photograph.
